configs.description: The chassis with two AC supplies and three fan modules fitted, front-to-rear air, before any part number: the shape every build below starts from.
configs.name: base

configs.description: Two DC supplies and front-to-rear air: PWR-1511-DC-RED supplies and FAN-7011H-F fan modules. The data sheet lists no DC part number for the switch; the supplies are spares, and a DC build is ordered through the "#" configurable SKUs.
configs.name: dc-f

configs.description: The 7280DR3-24 with two AC supplies and front-to-rear air: PWR-1511-AC-RED supplies and FAN-7011H-F fan modules, all with red handles. Ordered as DCS-7280DR3-24-F.
configs.name: f

configs.description: The 7280DR3K-24, the same hardware with 64 GB of memory and the large-routes licence, with front-to-rear air. Ordered as DCS-7280DR3K-24-F.
configs.name: k-f

gaps.note: Weight 13.1 kg (guide Table 1, 7280DR3-24 and DR3K-24) against 12.7 kg (data sheet), and typical / maximum power 560 W / 1110 W (guide Table 4) against 650 W / 1100 W (data sheet, the same cell as the PR3). The data sheet merges the PR3 and DR3 columns in these rows; the guide's per-model rows are used.
gaps.wanted: the maker's statement of which is current.

gaps.note: Storage temperature -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2) against -40 to 70 C (data sheet), and relative humidity 5 to 90 percent against 5 to 95 percent. The guide's, the older document by three months, are in attrs.
gaps.wanted: the maker's statement of which is current.

gaps.note: The 7280DR3K-24 has 64 GB of memory against 8 GB (64 GB optional) for the 7280DR3-24. No configuration can state a device attribute (the same open gap as cisco/asr-9001). The platform line names both.

The guide's Figures 3-1 to 3-4 are isometric drawings of another switch and carry no measure, and the kit guides for KIT-7001 and the other spares are not held, so no ear position or rail kit is written.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the mounting bracket position, and the kit guides.

gaps.note: Guide table 10 describes port LEDs near the ports and Figure C-2 draws white light-pipe bars on each cage but no lamp whose count or place can be read. No port lamp is modelled.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the lit face, or a larger figure.

gaps.note: The port-speed band's legends, the small print at the cages, the system and fan lamp glyphs and the PS1 and PS2 legends are unreadable in the 576 px figure. The glyphs and the two PS legends are drawn as read; the band and cage legends are not drawn.
Which side the latches of the stacked cages face is not visible in the figure. The library's belly-to-belly convention is used (upper cage upright, lower turned 180).
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the stacked cages.

gaps.note: The management block's arrow marks and its console symbol are drawn as the 7280CR3-32D4 draws them; the order of the three ports follows the datasheet's rear view and the library's other Arista stacks, and the figure's 1.24 px/mm resolves it only as three stacked ports.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the rear management block.

gaps.note: The PWR-1511-DC supplies are drawn as the AC supply's housing with a plain two-pole terminal block. The guide shows a DC supply only in isometric figures; the real terminal arrangement is not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a flat drawing or photograph of the PWR-1511-DC.

gaps.note: The guide's power tables and the data sheet give whole-switch figures only; the fan modules' missing power figure (lint L27) stands. The supplies state their output.
The 1RU grounding point is on the bottom of the chassis for KIT-GND-EXT-1RU (guide section 4.2, Table 5, Figure 4-2). No flat figure measures it, so it is not placed.
gaps.wanted: a flat drawing of the bottom with the grounding bracket holes.

chassis.note: Guide Table 1: 48.3 x 4.4 x 57.4 cm (19 x 1.75 x 22.6 in), 13.1 kg (29.0 lbs) for the 7280DR3-24 and the 7280DR3K-24. Data sheet: 43.99 x 4.37 x 57.4 cm, 28 lbs (12.7 kg), in cells it merges across the PR3 and the DR3 columns. The width: 48.3 cm is over the mounting ears, so the body between them, which is what is modelled, is the data sheet's 43.99 cm (440.0 here), a 21.5 mm ear each side. The height is the data sheet's 43.7. The depth is 574.0, the figure both documents give. The weight differs (gap `size-conflict`; the guide's per-model figure is in attrs). 1RU.

colour.note: The front plate is the 7280CR3-32D4's #aaabad, read there as the median of bare-plate pixels in the guide's figure of the same family.

configurations.note: Data sheet ordering information: DCS-7280DR3-24-F ("front to rear air, 2 x AC") and DCS-7280DR3K-24-F ("large routes, front to rear air, 2 x AC"). The "#" SKUs ("configurable fans and psu") and the "-M#" memory-expansion orders are orders of parts, not part numbers a DCIM can hold, and are not listed. The DR3K has 64 GB of memory and the large-routes licence and the same face, supplies and power draw, so it is a configuration with its own part number. The data sheet lists no DC build: the PWR-1511-DC-RED supply is a spare, so the DC configuration is an example with no part number.

ears.note: NOT MODELLED. The guide's Chapter 3 mounts the switch with the accessory-kit brackets and shows them in isometric drawings of a different switch ("Illustrations in this chapter depict the mounting of a DCS-7050QX-32S switch") that carry no measure. The data sheet lists the spares KIT-7001, KIT-2POST-1U-NT, KIT-4POST-NT, KIT-7001-4POST-L and KIT-GND-EXT-1RU. No figure measures a bracket position, and the kit guides are not held, so no ear position is written and no rail kit is listed in chassis.kits. Recorded in the gap rack-ears.

environment.note: Guide Table 2: operating 0 to 40 C, storage -25 to 70 C, altitude 0 to 3,000 m, humidity 5 to 90 percent non-condensing. Data sheet: operating 0 to 40 C, storage -40 to 70 C, humidity 5 to 95 percent, altitude 0 to 3,000 m. Storage temperature and humidity differ: gap `environment`, the guide's used.

front-legend.note: The vertical model legend reads "7280DR3-24" up the left plate. THE MAKER'S WORDMARK ABOVE THE FIRST COLUMN IS NOT DRAWN: a logo-zone region is reserved over it and the plain model text is set. The figure's small print is not legible, so the text is as the guide's caption names the model.

front-ports.note: Figure C-2 at 1.273 px/mm. Twenty-four QSFP-DD cages in two stacked rows of twelve columns (ports 1 to 24), the yellow boxes of the figure enclosing each column. The boxes' left edges sit on a 34.5 mm pitch, the first cage column centred 23.7 mm from the left. The rows read from the yellow boxes at 4.7 to 21.2 and 22.8 to 40.1 mm down, so the cage centres are 13.0 and 31.5 mm down and the row pitch is 18.5 mm. std/qsfp-dd@1 (registry 19.0 x 10.0 mm) is seated; the figure draws each box 24.4 mm wide with its bezel. The belly-to-belly orientation is the library's convention (upper cage upright, lower turned 180); the figure is too small to show the latch side.

fru-bays.note: Guide Appendix E (E.2 power supplies, E.3 fan modules) gives removal and installation procedures, and the data sheet calls the supplies "1+1 hot-swappable" and the fans "hot-swap". SO THE TWO POWER SUPPLIES AND THE THREE FAN MODULES ARE BAYS. Nothing on this chassis is a built-in unit. The management block, the USB port and the console port are part of the chassis and are placements.

gate-1-front.note: Figure C-2 passes. The raster is 576 x 117 pixels; the body measures 561 px wide and 57 px tall (aspect 9.8), against the data sheet's 440.0 / 43.7 = 10.07, so the figure is near-orthographic and carries geometry at 1.273 px/mm (the 440 mm body is the scale anchor, its left edge read at 8.7 px as for the sibling 7280CR3-32D4 face). One pixel is 0.8 mm, so every position is good to about 0.8 mm, and every one is `estimated` because it is read off a picture and no dimension states it. The old guide's Figure 50 is the same 576 x 117 raster, compared pixel for pixel (no pixel differs), so it is a repeat of the source and not a second reading. The status lamps are read from the green pixels of the lamps (550 px, 42 to 54 px down), which put them about 5 mm left of where the sibling 7280CR3-32D4 file puts its lamps (a reading of the same figure style).

gate-1-rear.note: Figure D-2 is a 552 x 126 px raster whose chassis is 544 px between its edges and 52 px tall (aspect 10.5; the 3 percent excess is the cut-off bottom edge), 1.239 px/mm over the 440 mm body; positions are good to about 0.8 mm. The guide draws the rear generically (D-1 to D-4) and does not say which model uses which. The 7280DR3-24 is mapped to D-2 by its three fan modules (data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 3 (N+1 redundant)"), its 1RU height, its two power supplies and its management ports at the rear (Figure C-2 has none at the front). THE MAPPING IS ESTIMATED. The positions are the 7280CR3-32D4's, which is mapped to the same figure.

interface-names.note: Not printed and not modelled. EOS names ports Ethernet1 to Ethernet24 and Management1; this is the vendor's convention and no held document prints it.

lifecycle.note: Searched 2026-10-23 (web searches of Arista's end-of-sale notices) for a notice for the 7280DR3-24 and 7280DR3K-24: none found. The notices the searches returned were for older 7280 models and for the 7280SR3K-48YC8 (notice 23789) and 7280CR3K-36S (notice 23790) series, not for this one.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat. The guide's installation figures are isometric. Each carries an `empty` sentence. The 1RU grounding point is on the bottom of the chassis (guide section 4.2, Table 5, KIT-GND-EXT-1RU); no figure measures it.

port-lamps.note: NOT MODELLED. Guide Appendix A.1.2, Table 10 says port LEDs sit near their ports (off link down, green link up, yellow software disabled, flashing yellow failed diagnostics), but Figure C-2 draws only white light-pipe bars on each cage and no lamp a reader can count. Recorded in the gap port-lamps.

port-numbering.note: Figure C-2 (callout 5, "Port numbers") prints 1 over 2, 3 over 4, and so on, 1 to 24 from the left, the odd number on the upper cage. The figure prints each number on a white tab over the cage opening; a seated cage hides what is painted under it, so the numerals are set in the band between the two rows, the odd number under its upper cage and the even above its lower one. EOS interface names (Ethernet1 to Ethernet24 and their breakouts) are not printed on the metal and are not modelled.

power.note: Guide Table 4: typical / maximum 560 W / 1110 W for the 7280DR3-24 and the 7280DR3K-24, each with PWR-1511-AC or PWR-1511-DC. The data sheet gives 650 W / 1100 W for the DR3 columns, the same cell it gives the PR3 (gap `size-conflict`). The guide's per-model figure is used; the data sheet's typical is "measured at 25C ambient with 50% load on all ports".

rear.note: Figure D-2 at 1.239 px/mm, the rear seen from behind with x = 0 at the left of the drawing. PS1 is the left and PS2 the right (callouts 1 and 10). Each power supply module is 73.5 mm wide (the data sheet's "73.5MM") at 4.0 and 362.3 mm across and 1.85 mm down. The management block is a grey plate 83.0 to 101.0 mm across with the Ethernet management port, the USB port and the RJ-45 console port stacked in it, in the order the library draws other Arista management stacks. Three fan modules 78.6 mm wide at 107.7, 191.0 and 274.3 mm across (an 83.3 mm pitch) and 2.55 mm down.

rear-fan.note: Data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 3 (N+1 redundant)", "Fan Tray FAN-7011H" and the spare FAN-7011H-F (front-to-rear airflow). The data sheet gives the DR3 front-to-rear airflow only and lists no FAN-7011H-R for it. Guide section 2.1: a red handle is an air-exit module. The three fan modules are bays that accept the FAN-7011H-F.

sources.note: 7280R3 Series Quick Start Guide, Arista Networks, document DOC-07041-01, 63 pages, PDF created 2025-05-16 (https://www.arista.com/assets/data/pdf/qsg/qsg-books/QS_7280R3.pdf): Table 1 (dimensions and weights), Table 2 (operating and storage), Table 3 (power input), Table 4 (power draw and supported supplies), section 2.1 (airflow orientation, handle colour), Table 5 (grounding), section 4.5 (serial and management cables), Appendix A (status indicators, Tables 9 to 13), Appendix C (Figure C-2, the front panel of the DCS-7280DR3-24 and DCS-7280DR3K-24), Appendix D (Figure D-2, the rear panel with three fan modules), Appendix E (field replacement). 7280 Data Center Switches Quick Start Guide, Arista Networks, 58 pages, PDF created 2022-06-03 (https://www.arista.com/assets/data/pdf/qsg/qsg-books/QS_7280_1RU_Gen3.pdf): Figure 50 (DCS-7280DR3-24 and 7280DR3K-24), the cross-check of Figure C-2. 7280R3 Series Data Center Switch Router Data Sheet, Arista Networks, 03-0045-59, dated August 11th, 2025 (https://www.arista.com/assets/data/pdf/Datasheets/7280R3-Data-Sheet.pdf): the model comparison of the 7280PR3-24, PR3K-24, DR3-24 and DR3K-24, the power supply specifications and the ordering information. Held and checked first: intake COVERAGE.md and SOURCES.md, which list no photograph, Visio stencil, 3D model or CAD file for this model (Arista publishes none; the stencil zip could not be fetched). The data sheet's picture of the face is a thumbnail. No drawing, photograph or logo is copied into the library, only transcribed facts and new drawings.

speed-strips.note: Guide Figure C-2 callout 6, "Port-speed group": a thin grey band between the two rows carries a small legend at each column's left and right ends. The legends are unreadable at 85 ppi and are not drawn. The figure also prints a small orange tag on the band between columns 13 and 14, unreadable.

status-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.1, Table 9 and Figure C-2 callouts 1 to 4: a system status lamp (blinking green on power-up, green normal, blue locator, amber for two or more failed fans), a fan status lamp (green, amber for one module removed or failed, red for two or more) and a status lamp for each of the two power supplies (green operating, off removed or faulty). Four lamps in a column at 425.6 mm, about 3.2 mm apart from 8.1 mm down. The printed glyphs beside them are a system symbol, a fan symbol and two small legends read as PS1 and PS2.

vents.note: The figure shows a perforated strip along the top (1.0 to 4.6 mm down, across nearly the whole width), a small grid of dark squares in each gap between two cage columns, two grids at the left of the first column and a three-by-three grid right of the last, and a ribbed strip along the bottom lip. Each is drawn as a vent field in its measured extent, not square by square.
